title: Alerts and the log
summary: The log says what just happened. Tap a line marked ◎ to look there.
text:
The log runs down the side of the screen: a new building online, a deposit running dry, research done, a colonist saying something, a pack sighted.

When something of yours is hit, lost or found, you hear it, the radar map pings the spot and the log line gets a **◎**. Tap the line (or press H for the latest alert) and the camera goes straight there.

Radio messages show in their own corner panel. Most close by themselves after a while; ones that matter to the story stay until you tap them (**tap to close**), and the most important come in as a full card marked **Radio** and pause the game. All of them stay in the log.

If something goes wrong and you're not sure why, the log is the first place to look.

Lines fade after a few seconds, but nothing is lost: the **Message log** (press L, or the menu → Message log) keeps everything the log said this visit, newest first, with the time. **Warnings and alerts** shows just those; tap a line with ◎ to go there. With a screen reader, warnings and alerts are read out as they come in.
